name: Lonely Kids Around the Cul-de-sac
source:
Lonely Kids Around the Cul-de-sac is a short visual novel where you play as a kid trick-or-treating with his best friend a Halloween night.

[From [url=https://pizzapranks.itch.io/indiepocalypse-24]Indiepocalypse #24[/url]]
translation:
《Lonely Kids Around the Cul-de-sac》是一部短篇视觉小说。你将扮演一个孩子，在万圣节之夜和最好的朋友一起挨家挨户讨糖。

[摘自[url=https://pizzapranks.itch.io/indiepocalypse-24]Indiepocalypse第24期[/url]]
